label: Expressive truth predicate: Expressive truth: for every P: Prop some content c has truth c ↔ P
definition: `Expressive truth`: for every `P : Prop` some content `c` has `truth c ↔ P`.
note: Stipulated bridge between a content language and `Prop`. Not claimed of any natural language; a rival may deny it for the predicate it denies.
